products.name: Software License Usage Reporting & Cost Dashboards (Power BI) — Commercial
products.short_description: A repeatable license usage and cost reporting layer in Power BI — dashboards for deployment, usage, expirations, reharvesting, and cost efficiency, fed from your license and discovery data and refreshed on a schedule. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Turn license data into dashboards leadership and procurement actually use

License and spend data sits in exports nobody reads — so renewals surprise you, savings go unclaimed, and leadership can't see where the money goes. This solution builds a repeatable license usage and cost reporting layer in Power BI: dashboards for deployment, usage, expiration timelines, reharvesting opportunities, and cost-efficiency metrics, fed from your license and discovery data, refreshed on a schedule.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the license/spend reporting model, data sources (license inventory, usage, contracts), the KPI set (deployment, usage, expirations, cost-per-seat, savings), and the dashboard refresh cycle.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Power BI / Excel Power Query, access to license and usage data, a renewals/contract source, a reporting destination) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: define the KPI set, connect license and usage data, build the dashboards, set scheduled refresh and distribution, validate the numbers, then pilot, validate, and expand coverage.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — reporting-data discovery, data-reconciliation validation, a consolidated license usage and cost report, a scheduled export helper, and a reporting-scope group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

License usage and spend made visible — deployment, expirations, reharvesting, and cost-efficiency dashboards leadership and procurement actually use — refreshed on a schedule, proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • LICRPT-Discovery.ps1 — discover the license and usage data sources available for reporting
    • LICRPT-Export-Scheduled.ps1 — export the license/usage extract that feeds the Power BI dataset
    • LICRPT-Report.ps1 — produce the license KPI set independently of Power BI
    • LICRPT-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — build/update the reporting-scope and distribution audience groups
    • LICRPT-Validation.ps1 — reconcile reported license counts against the source (the reconciliation gate)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
